sessionName: Week 7 - Founder campaigns and thought leadership
summary: George Berrington ran the marketing session with James Whitlow and Sophie Archer. Ashcombe has almost no visible content and founders rarely recognise the name. We agreed a sector-led content plan and a quarterly founder report to back outbound.

discussion.keyPoints: Sophie said fewer than 1 in 10 founders contacted had heard of Ashcombe. James is reluctant to be personally visible on LinkedIn.
The team has proprietary data from 4 platforms on pricing and labour costs in facilities and compliance services.
Two former founders are happy to speak on record.

recommendations.recommendation: Publish a quarterly UK Business Services Founder Report using anonymised portfolio data, first edition in April.
James to post on LinkedIn twice a month about buy-and-build lessons.
Produce two founder video case studies, starting with the compliance testing platform founder.
Track report downloads that turn into a first meeting within 90 days.

actions.action: Scope the first Founder Report and data sources
Contact the two former founders to schedule filming

nextFocus: Review intermediary and adviser relationships as a channel.
nextPreparation: Sophie to list the top 20 intermediaries by deals shown in the last 3 years.

tests.question: When is the first Founder Report due?
Did James agree to post on LinkedIn?
Which case study are we doing first?
